A1 prototype • CAD renders • not a fabrication release • 2026-10-24
A hardware LED follows the 3.3 V rail, independently
A proposed heartbeat follows accepted scan progress.
A live UI task alone must not assert RUN.
128 × 64 monochrome status: RUN, STOP or FAULT, scan
The screen is deliberately small and non-touch. The displayed DEMO content is a UI proposal; the A1 OLED driver and status integration still need
